note: Silent footage from the test-mode build (NEXT_PUBLIC_SUBMISSION_MODE=1) on the demo sandbox's fictional sample books. AI readings in it come from the test-mode stub, not a live model. Regenerate: tools/video/regenerate.sh

sequences.title: Judges' video: 3-minute submission video, timed shot list

shots.what: what existed before the event. black card, white text (still, 1280 × 720). card holds for the full 8 s:
shots.caption: Only Spark hardware predates the event
shots.vo: Before the hackathon I had only my DGX Spark with Ollama. Everything else was built after kickoff.
shots.card:
Before the hackathon I had only my DGX Spark with Ollama.
Everything else was built after kickoff.
Repo created 26 Oct 2026 22:30 UTC, after kickoff 26 Oct 16:00 UK.
First Meta model commit 23:18 UTC. (docs/PROVENANCE.md)

shots.what: one dashboard for the compulsory part. Home dashboard (/), demo sandbox with the SAMPLE — FICTIONAL COMPANY banner over six months of the fictional joinery's books. slow scroll down the dashboard: cash in and out, amounts owed, then rest on the Coming up deadlines card (VAT return, quarterly Income Tax update, Self Assessment 31 January).
shots.caption: Digital records and MTD deadlines, one dashboard
shots.vo: Accnomos helps UK small businesses, sole traders and landlords with the compulsory part: digital records and Making Tax Digital filings. The dashboard shows cash, what is owed, and what is due: the VAT return, quarterly Income Tax updates, and Self Assessment on 31 January.

shots.what: paperwork starts on the phone. Android app capture, then web Review (/review). photograph a receipt in the Android app; cut to the same document waiting in web Review; point at the sender line of a supplier email picked up by Outlook intake.
shots.caption: Phone photos and email become your books
shots.vo: Paperwork starts on the phone. Photograph a receipt in the Android app and it lands in your own OneDrive. Forward a supplier email and Outlook intake picks it up, read only. Nothing posts without your tap.
shots.live: Android camera capture and an Outlook email: film on the phone and a throwaway mailbox

shots.what: a Meta model reads, code checks. web Review (/review), one proposal card. point at the reader line (Muse Glimmer 30B), the code checks and repaired figures, then the Verifier line: second reading agrees on all six fields. Do not film the mic.
shots.caption: Meta models read, code checks, you approve
shots.vo: A Meta model reads each document: Muse Glimmer 30B with open weights, or Muse Spark with your key. Code checks the arithmetic and repairs VAT-inclusive totals. A second independent reading checks six fields before you approve.
shots.live: the reader line must name a live Meta model reading, not the test stub

shots.what: measured numbers. full-screen eval card (still, 1280 × 720). Burn in exactly:
shots.caption: 200 synthetic documents, measured accuracy
shots.vo: Measured on 200 synthetic documents: every field right on 91 per cent clean and 93 messy for Muse Spark Open, 85 and 80 for Glimmer. Ask answers 32 of 32 figures exact. Real photos will score lower.
shots.card:
200 synthetic gold documents, all fields right
Muse Spark Open (Baseten, key mode)   91 % clean, 93 % messy, about 13 s each
Muse Glimmer 30B (open weights)       85 % clean, 80 % messy, about 18-24 s each
Ask: figures exact 32 of 32, no invented figure shown
Synthetic documents: real phone photos will score lower

shots.what: approve posts an event; books live in OneDrive. web Review (/review) → Files (/files). press Approve on the card; open _System/Ledger/events and show the new event file; open the books folder and show Books.xlsx beside it.
shots.caption: Immutable ledger in your own OneDrive
shots.vo: Approving writes an immutable ledger event, never an edit. Your books are files in your own OneDrive: ledger events and Books.xlsx. There is no Accnomos database, so disconnecting loses nothing.

shots.what: VAT by code, sandbox, test gates. VAT return (/vat), then the HMRC sandbox declaration card. point at the nine boxes worked out by code; walk through Connect to HMRC (sandbox), obligations and the legal declaration; hold on the sandbox receipt in 06 VAT returns/.
shots.caption: VAT by code, HMRC sandbox only
shots.vo: The nine VAT boxes are worked out by code in whole pence, then walked through HMRC's sandbox flow after the legal declaration. Tested with 1260 runtime checks, 208 browser tests and 248 app tests.
shots.live: HMRC's sandbox (the demo simulates it): film with a real sandbox connection

shots.what: email receipt in, proposal ready. Settings (/settings) Outlook intake → web Review (/review). press Check my inbox now; the emailed supplier receipt lands in 00 Inbox; its proposal card opens with supplier, date and totals filled in.
shots.caption: Email receipt in, proposal ready
shots.vo: Watch one receipt travel. A supplier email arrives in Outlook and intake copies it to the inbox. The proposal shows supplier, date and totals, with a second reading agreeing on all six fields.
shots.live: Outlook intake needs a real (throwaway) mailbox and a live reading

shots.what: approve, then the AI summary. web Review (/review) → Home dashboard (/). press Approve; cut to Home where the AI summary now reflects the new entry; point at one checked figure and its source.
shots.caption: Approve once, summary explains
shots.vo: I approve and it posts to the ledger. Home's AI summary words the position in plain sentences, every figure checked against the books.
shots.live: Home's AI summary is the test stub's: film with a live model

shots.what: VAT return in the HMRC sandbox. VAT return (/vat), sandbox flow. the return shows the boxes the receipt changed; connect to HMRC's sandbox, tick the declaration, submit; hold on the receipt saved to 06 VAT returns/.
shots.caption: VAT return submitted to sandbox
shots.vo: The VAT return shows the boxes the receipt changed. I connect to HMRC's sandbox, confirm the declaration, and submit. The receipt lands in my OneDrive.
shots.live: HMRC's sandbox (the demo simulates it): film with a real sandbox connection

shots.what: voice, then end card. Ask (/ask), then end card over Home. hold the mic button and say the line; the timesheet card appears; cut to the end card: github.com/zaytunazs/accnomos · Sample data · HMRC sandbox · docs/HONESTY.md lists every gap.
shots.caption: Voice becomes an approval card
shots.vo: By voice: Andy did 2 hours overtime at double time on the Hendon job. It becomes a card I approve.
shots.end_card: github.com/zaytunazs/accnomos · Sample data · HMRC sandbox · docs/HONESTY.md lists every gap
shots.live: voice (Muse Voice Transcribe) has never been run live: docs/HONESTY.md

shots.what: Settings (/settings), Outlook intake: Switch Outlook intake on; press Check my inbox now; the emailed receipt lands in 00 Inbox
shots.caption: Email intake reads, never sends
shots.vo: Supplier emails are picked up from Outlook with read-only access. Intake copies likely receipts to the inbox and logs them. It never sends, moves or deletes your mail.
shots.live: Outlook intake needs a real (throwaway) mailbox

shots.what: Android app: Photograph a printed receipt; the crop preview appears; send it
shots.caption: Phone photo straight to OneDrive
shots.vo: Or snap it on the phone. The photo goes to your own OneDrive first, then to the reader.

shots.what: Review (/review): Both documents wait as proposal cards with supplier, date and totals
shots.caption: Two arrivals, one Review queue
shots.vo: Both land in one Review queue as proposals. Nothing posts until you approve.

shots.what: Home dashboard (/): Scroll the dashboard: cash in and out, amounts owed, Coming up deadlines
shots.caption: Cash, owed and due at a glance
shots.vo: Home is one dashboard: money in and out this month, who owes you, what you owe, and what is coming up. Cards for features you never use stay hidden.

shots.what: Home dashboard (/), summary card: Point at the AI summary, then at one figure and the page it links to
shots.caption: Summary worded, figures checked
shots.vo: The AI summary words the position in two to four sentences. Code checks every figure against the books first, and an invented number is replaced by the facts. The card says who wrote it.
shots.live: the AI summary is the test stub's: film with a live model

shots.what: VAT return (/vat): Open the quarter picker; point at the nine boxes and the ledger lines behind Box 4
shots.caption: Nine boxes worked out by code
shots.vo: The nine VAT boxes are calculated by code from approved entries, in whole pence. No model touches them. Each box opens the ledger lines behind it.

shots.what: VAT return (/vat), sandbox flow: Connect to HMRC sandbox, open obligations, tick the legal declaration, submit, hold on the receipt
shots.caption: Filed through HMRC sandbox only
shots.vo: Then walk through the Making Tax Digital flow: connect to HMRC's sandbox, check the obligations, confirm the declaration and submit. The receipt is saved to your OneDrive.

shots.what: Settings (/settings), then Self-employment (/self-employment): Switch on I am self-employed; the Income Tax page appears with quarterly updates
shots.caption: Quarterly updates, sandbox only
shots.vo: Sole traders switch on self-employment in Settings. Quarterly figures are worked out from approved entries, with the ledger lines behind each box.

shots.what: Property (/property): Open a registered property; point at the rental income and its share for the year
shots.caption: Landlords see each property
shots.vo: Landlords register each property and see its rental income for the year, with expenses beside it.

shots.what: Self-employment (/self-employment): Point at the cumulative period summary and the HMRC calculation shown as HMRC's
shots.caption: Confirm, submit, receipt filed
shots.vo: Tick to confirm, submit the update through the sandbox, and the receipt is filed in your books.
shots.live: the MTD Income Tax sandbox submission

shots.what: CIS (/cis): Open the contractor view; point at a subcontractor's status and the deduction worked out by code
shots.caption: Deductions worked out by code
shots.vo: For contractors, each subcontractor's verification status sets the deduction rate, and code works out every deduction to the penny from the bills.

shots.what: CIS (/cis): Open the CIS300 figures and the CSV file in 07 Reports/CIS/; hold on the filing reminder
shots.caption: Figures ready, you file them
shots.vo: The CIS300 figures and file are prepared for you. Accnomos never submits them: you file through HMRC's CIS online service, then match the payment in the bank.

shots.what: Payroll (/payroll): Enter hours and rates for one employee; confirm the pay run; point at the gross, tax and National Insurance lines
shots.caption: Pay runs estimated in pence
shots.vo: Enter hours and rates to get a pay-run estimate, line by line in whole pence. These are estimates for planning, not filings.

shots.what: Payroll (/payroll), downloads: Download the payslip, the RTI files and the pension schedule; open Basic PAYE Tools beside them
shots.caption: Files ready for PAYE Tools
shots.vo: Download the payslips, the FPS and EPS files and the pension schedule, then file them with HMRC's Basic PAYE Tools. Accnomos never files payroll or pays HMRC itself.

shots.what: Ask (/ask): Hold the mic button and say the overtime line; the timesheet card appears; press Approve
shots.caption: Speak it, approve the card
shots.vo: Andy did 2 hours overtime at double time on the Hendon job. It becomes a timesheet card, and nothing is recorded until I approve.
shots.live: voice has never been run live, and the stub cannot turn the line into a timesheet card

shots.what: Ask (/ask): Type a quote request; the quote card appears with priced lines; press Approve
shots.caption: Quotes priced by code
shots.vo: Ask for a quote and the model returns only an intent. Code finds the customer, prices every line in pence, and waits.
shots.live: the stub cannot price a quote from chat: film with a live model

shots.what: Ask (/ask): Say the shopping-list line; it lands in the to-dos tile on Home
shots.caption: Small asks become to-dos
shots.vo: Remember to order 2-inch bolts for the Hendon job. Small asks become to-dos instead of paperwork.
shots.live: the stub cannot turn the line into a to-do: film with a live model

shots.what: Accountant (/accountant): Open a shared set of books; move between its ledger, Books.xlsx and the audit trail
shots.caption: Your accountant sees your files
shots.vo: Your accountant opens the same files you see: the ledger, the spreadsheet and the audit trail. Every change is recorded under their name.
shots.live: the accountant portal needs books shared through Microsoft Graph (not in the demo)

shots.what: Reports and exports (/reports/exports): Pick the VAT return as sent and the SA103 summary; export both; point at the files in 07 Reports/
shots.caption: Reports out, ready to send
shots.vo: Export the VAT return as sent, the Income Tax summary and the full ledger as PDF, spreadsheet or CSV. Anything they question is undone with a reversing entry, never a delete.
